create_make_transforms: create video augmentation pipeline with make_transforms using configurable flip, resize, crop, and normalization options
build_video_transform: build a VideoTransform instance for applying spatial transforms, horizontal flip, and pixel-wise random erasing to video buffers
test_tensor_normalize: test tensor_normalize function that converts uint8 tensors to float and normalizes by subtracting mean and dividing by std
review_video_transform_call: review VideoTransform.__call__ method that converts buffers, resizes crops, flips, normalizes, and optionally applies random erasing
summarize_tensor_normalize_inplace: summarize _tensor_normalize_inplace function that normalizes CTHW tensors in-place by subtracting mean and dividing by std
